cli.usage:
Usage:
  thulu-gates run [--base <ref>] [--out <dir>] [--only a,b] [--skip a,b] [--perf] [--mutation]
                  [--critical <glob>]... [--coverage-min 80] [--dup-max 3] [--quiet]
                  [--cache-dir <dir>] [--quarantine <file>] [--profile <file>] [--reuse]
  thulu-gates doctor [--json]

Checks: tests, coverage_new, duplication, lint, typecheck, sast, secrets, deps, licenses,
phantom_deps, suppressions, mutation (with --mutation), perf (with --perf).
Base: git merge-base origin/<default> HEAD. Out: $TMPDIR/thulu-gates/<timestamp>.
Exit: 0 pass, 1 blocking findings, 2 tool error.
cli.no_base: neither origin/{branch} nor {branch} exists in this clone, so there is no base to compare against. Pass --base <commit>: the task brief gives it as the base commit
cli.config_unparsable: {path} is not valid JSON; using the defaults
cli.start: thulu-gates: base {base}, head {head}, {files} changed files, stack: {stacks}
cli.out_contains_repo: --out {out} is the repo or one of its parent directories; pick a directory of its own
cli.worktree_failed: could not check out base in a worktree: {detail}
cli.quarantine_unreadable: the quarantine file {path} is not valid JSON; no test is left out and it will not be written
cli.quarantine_not_saved: could not write the quarantine file {path}: {detail}
cli.profile_missing: the gate profile {path} does not exist; running without it
cli.profile_unparsable: the gate profile {path} is not a JSON object; running without it
cli.profile_no_entry: the gate profile {path} has no entry for {name} (it has: {names}); running without it
cli.config_accept_ignored: {path} sets accept_unverified, which only the project profile in Thulu can set; ignored
cli.accept_not_object: accept_unverified in the gate profile {path} must map check ids to reasons; ignored
cli.accept_unknown_check: accept_unverified in the gate profile {path} names an unknown check {id} (checks: {ids}); ignored
cli.accept_no_reason: accept_unverified in the gate profile {path} gives {id} no reason; a person has to write why, so it is not accepted
cli.reuse_dirty: not reusing a stored report: the tree has uncommitted or untracked files
cli.reuse_miss: no stored report for this head, base and config; running the checks

common.base_not_compared: base could not be checked, so nothing was compared with it

tests.no_projects: the diff touches no project with tests
tests.no_runner: no test runner found for the touched projects
tests.base_incomplete: the base run did not cover the suite, so it is no baseline
tests.hangs_on_base: {name} does not finish, on base either: quarantined
tests.hangs_head: {name} does not finish on this branch; {where}
tests.cannot_exclude: this runner cannot leave a single test out
tests.rest_not_verified: the run stopped after {seconds} s; the rest of the suite is not verified
tests.quarantine_unsupported: quarantined tests ran anyway ({runners} cannot leave a single test out)
tests.no_report: the runner exited without its results report
tests.karma_disconnected: Karma ran {executed} of {total} tests and the browser disconnected
tests.karma_error: Karma ran {executed} of {total} tests and ended in ERROR

coverage.no_report: the tests ran but left no coverage report (install a coverage provider, e.g. @vitest/coverage-v8 or pytest-cov)
coverage.no_tests_run: no coverage: the tests check did not run
coverage.no_data_for: no coverage data for the changed files: {files}
coverage.below_ungated: {pct}% of new lines covered ({covered}/{total}); under {lines} new lines, not gated
coverage.file_no_data: no coverage report mentions this file: no test loaded it, or the runner only reports files the tests import
coverage.uncovered: new lines {lines} never ran in the tests
coverage.tests_not_finished: not verified: the tests check did not finish, so its coverage covers only part of the suite

duplication.fail: {pct}% of new lines duplicated ({dup}/{total}, maximum {max}%); {clones} clones
duplication.clone_base: lines {start}-{end} repeat {other}:{otherStart}-{otherEnd}, a copy already on base

lint.no_projects: the diff touches no project to lint
lint.clean: no lint findings on new lines
lint.clean_partial: no lint findings on new lines; not run: {missing}
lint.not_configured: no linter configured for the touched files (eslint or prettier config, golangci-lint, ruff...)
lint.not_formatted_base: not formatted ({tool}), already so on base
lint.complexity_base: {fn} has complexity {ccn}, over {max}; it was {old} on base

typecheck.no_projects: the diff touches no project to type-check
typecheck.nothing_to_check: no type checker configured for the touched projects
typecheck.clean_preexisting: no new type errors ({count} already on base)

secrets.builtin_clean: no secrets on new lines (gitleaks not installed; built-in patterns only)

builtin_found.one: {count} secret on new lines (built-in patterns; gitleaks not installed)
builtin_found.other: {count} secrets on new lines (built-in patterns; gitleaks not installed)

secrets.clean: no secrets in the branch's commits or uncommitted files

deps.not_found: {name} does not exist in the {ecosystem} registry
deps.version_not_found: {name}@{version} does not exist in the registry

phantom_fail.one: {count} dependency does not resolve in its registry
phantom_fail.other: {count} dependencies do not resolve in their registry

unreachable.one: registry unreachable for {count} package; existence not verified
unreachable.other: registry unreachable for {count} packages; existence not verified

all_exist.one: {count} changed dependency exists in its registry
all_exist.other: {count} changed dependencies exist in their registries

vuln_fail.one: {count} fixable high or critical vulnerability in changed dependencies
vuln_fail.other: {count} fixable high or critical vulnerabilities in changed dependencies

deps.vuln_preexisting: no new vulnerabilities ({count} already on base)

licenses.not_in_default: {name} is licensed {license}, outside the default permissive list (set licenses_allow to decide)

fail.one: {count} dependency with a license outside licenses_allow
fail.other: {count} dependencies with a license outside licenses_allow

ok.one: {count} changed dependency with an allowed license

suppressions.gate_config: {file} configures a gate; a change here needs a person's approval
suppressions.no_reason: {kind} without a reason of at least {min} words on the same line

fail.one: {count} suppression or gate-config change needs attention
fail.other: {count} suppressions or gate-config changes need attention

valid_only.one: {count} new suppression, with rule and reason
valid_only.other: {count} new suppressions, each with rule and reason

mutation.nothing_changed: no changed source lines to mutate
mutation.mutmut_config: mutmut 3 reads its targets from [tool.mutmut] source_paths (paths_to_mutate in older 3.x releases); add it to pyproject.toml
mutation.survivors: {survived} of {total} mutants survived or no test reached them (efficacy {efficacy}%)
mutation.no_mutants: the tool produced no mutants on the changed lines

perf.nothing_to_run: no Go benchmarks in the changed packages and no perf.command in .thulu/gates.json
perf.no_base_worktree: could not check out base to compare against
perf.hyperfine_no_times: hyperfine finished on {side} but its JSON has no run times ({file})
perf.method: Base and head interleaved on the same machine, {rounds} rounds; two-sided Mann-Whitney U, median with 95% CI.

missing.one: {count} tool missing; checks that need it report skip with the install command.
missing.other: {count} tools missing; checks that need them report skip with the install command.

report.quarantine_added: Quarantined in this run (they fail or hang on base too)
report.quarantine_file: Quarantine file: `{path}`. Delete an entry to run that test again.
report.accepted_line: accepted: {reason}. Why it was not verified: {why}
report.reused: Reused from {time} (the run in `{out}`): no check ran again.
report.reused_partly: Reused from {time} (the run in `{out}`); ran again: {ids}.
